title: [Switch 2] Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade $13.99, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth $12.74 @ Nintendo eShop
body:
Deal: [Switch 2] Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade $13.99, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth $12.74 @ Nintendo eShop

[crazyhor77] wow, didnt expect this price on rebirth so soon. ty!
[kingarthur] I am surprised too. The best deal of the year!
[Buttershoes] Does the digital deluxe version get you anything extra other than the digital art books?
[MHH] Gawdamn Rebirth cheaper than Remake Intergrade. Glad I didn't buy Rebirth in the last sale.
[Panama] So cheap that i got them just to have them. Wish they’d deeply discounted all their other square games like this.
[Dealf Hunter] Awesome games (although I played them on PC, so not sure how they look and perform on Switch 2).
[Zythyx] Makes sense for them to markdown Remake and Rebirth so heavily so that they can prepare for Revelations sales (catch people up in the story)
[theguyrules] Damn glad I didn’t pick it up yet as I wasn’t ready to play it.
[YoursTruly] The games take a big chunk of storage, if all you have is the 256GB inbuilt storage
Rebirth 91.5GB
Remake 90.4GB
[Kerrby] How are the Switch 2 ports of these games? Worth giving a go or better sticking to PS5?
[SeanConnery] This video here is a good showcase:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VQ6qPX0jH7g
Base PS5 is definitely better. Switch 2 is not bad at all though. Still very playable. A lot more lower res shadows and aliasing on Switch 2. Also a lot less environmental detail on Switch 2, noticeable in interiors.
Note: I played Rebirth at launch on base PS5 and was quite disappointed by how soft the image looked, even in quality mode. Not sure if they've patched it up since then.
[stormtrooper-c] I'm about 80 hours into Rebirth on PC. If only there was a way to port the save over, damn good price.
[Swankenstein] Yeah I feel this. Especially since there is a lot of side content that soaks up those hours
